verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms LibreChat publishes an llms.txt at librechat.ai, described as a "curated map of the LibreChat documentation for language models and coding agents." A second probe confirms markdown renderings of its docs (docs.md, and .md URLs for feature pages), so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs, and evidence of how complete the llms.txt map is (e.g. a full-content variant).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Curated map of the LibreChat documentation for language models and coding agents.
